mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market overheating signal—defined as a 0.3 percentage point increase in the unemployment rate over three consecutive months—indicates rising labor cost pressures and imminent Fed tightening, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the signal fails to predict negative returns with statistical significance (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A synchronized decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which triggers a risk-off shift in equity markets and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns over 60 days (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average, combined with a concurrent rise in the unemployment rate, indicates a supply-side shock that disrupts corporate earnings and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12-month MA and UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered events (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction signal fails to outperform a single-series model (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) remains above 3.5% year-over-year, the market prices in a prolonged high-rate environment, leading to compressed equity valuations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances or the interaction signal fails to achieve Rank IC > 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average, combined with rising industrial production (INDPRO), signals strong underlying demand momentum that supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 12-month MA and INDPRO rises > 0.5pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during triggered events (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction signal fails to outperform a single-series benchmark (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A labor market recovery signal—defined as a 100,000+ increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over three consecutive months—indicates improving economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to achieve Rank IC > 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average, combined with a decline in housing starts (HOUST), indicates a weakening consumer demand cycle that reduces corporate revenue visibility and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 12-month MA and HOUST declines > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered events (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction signal fails to achieve Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year window.
